type: Lockstitch sewing machine electronic controller with auto presser foot lifter

interfaces.socket1: Foot pedal, update & electronic knee socket
interfaces.socket2: Electromagnet, LED lamp and thickness sensor socket
interfaces.socket3: Air suction device, bird's nest interface and rear tugboat

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor overcurrent (hardware) — encoder or electronic control damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. Replace if damaged. Contact local service provider if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor overcurrent (software)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. Contact local service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: System undervoltage — input supply voltage too low (below 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power and check if input supply voltage is below 176V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. Contact local service provider if voltage is normal but problem persists.

errorCodes.cause: Overvoltage during shutdown — input power supply voltage too high (above 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage is above 264V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. Contact service if voltage is normal but problem persists.

errorCodes.cause: Overvoltage during operation — input power supply voltage too high (above 264V) while sewing
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage is above 264V. Restart after voltage normalizes. Contact service if problem persists.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Try a few times. If fault occurs frequently, contact local service provider.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor stalled — foreign object wrapped around machine head, motor plug loose or broken, eccentric wheel stuck
errorCodes.solution: Check for foreign objects or thread residue wrapped in rotating shuttle. Check if eccentric wheel is stuck. Disconnect power and check arm shaft motor power input plug. Restart after correction. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Panel communication failure — connection between operation panel and electric control dropped, loose, or broken
errorCodes.solution: Check connection between operation panel and electric control. Restore and restart. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor initial angle detection failure
errorCodes.solution: Try 2-3 times again after power off. Contact local service provider if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor zero position fault — encoder damaged or in poor condition
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. Replace if needed. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Master control EEPROM components read/write failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Contact local service provider if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor overspeed protection — encoder damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Check arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control for damage. Replace if needed. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor reverse
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Check encoder and electronic control. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Panel date read/write failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Contact local service provider if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Arm shaft motor overload — motor may be stalled
errorCodes.solution: Check whether arm shaft motor is stalled. If not stalled, contact local service provider.

errorCodes.cause: Motor type mismatch
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Contact local service provider if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Pedal error — pedal speed controller connection cable dropped, loose, or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Check if pedal speed controller cable is loose or damaged. Restore and restart. Contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Backstitch step motor hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check reverse sew motor socket. Restart electric control. Contact local service if error is still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Backstitch step motor software overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check reverse sew motor socket. Restart electric control. Contact local service if error is still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Backstitch step motor current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check socket of reverse sew motor, restart electric control. Contact local service if still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Backstitch step motor stalled
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check socket of reverse sew motor, restart electric control. Contact local service if still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Backstitch step motor zero position fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check socket of reverse sew motor, restart electric control. Contact local service if still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Reverse stitch stepping motor encoder AB signal abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, check socket of reverse sew motor, restart electric control. Contact local service if still reported.

errorCodes.cause: Password lock shutdown alarm — machine use time limit has been reached
errorCodes.solution: The machine has reached the set time. If further use is required, contact your local service provider.

alarmCodes.cause: Safety switch alarm — machine head is not in normal position
alarmCodes.solution: Return machine head to normal position to ensure safety switch rebounds.

alarmCodes.cause: Machine head button with short circuit alarm
alarmCodes.solution: Turn off system power and change the light button of machine head.

alarmCodes.cause: Needle count reaches full count (counter alarm)
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key briefly to cancel the alarm. Refer to parameter P43 description.

alarmCodes.cause: Piece count reaches full count (counter alarm)
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key briefly to cancel the alarm. Refer to parameter P90 description.

alarmCodes.cause: Thickness sensor is not connected — wiring terminal connection issue
alarmCodes.solution: Check if wiring terminal of thickness sensor is connected to electronic control unit. Press P key briefly to cancel alarm.

alarmCodes.cause: Communication alarm between adapter board and electronic control unit
alarmCodes.solution: Turn off system power and on again. If still occurs, check if electronic control unit is damaged or upgrade adapter board program to latest version. After 10 seconds on alarm screen, alarm auto-cancels. Can cancel by briefly pressing P key.

alarmCodes.cause: Power off — power switch turned off or input voltage too low
alarmCodes.solution: After power switch is turned off, panel shows OFF and returns to normal when power is turned on again. Check if input voltage is too low.

values.3: ascending count to full — alarm and stop
values.5: ascending count to full — remind and keep running
values.6: descending to 0 — alarm and keep running

Restart system after correction
Contact service if still failing

Check power outlet and cable condition
Try restarting after ensuring stable power supply
Turn off power and turn on again
Check if electronic control unit is damaged
Consider upgrading adapter board program to latest version
Alarm auto-cancels after 10 seconds or press P key to cancel
Return machine head to its normal upright position
Ensure the safety switch rebounds correctly
Check thickness sensor wiring terminal connection to electronic control unit
Ensure connector is firmly seated

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine thread trimming not working correctly
checks: Check P38 trimmer switch is set to 1 (on)
Check P31 trimming strength coefficient — may need adjustment
Check P35 thread clamp switch is enabled

troubleshooting.symptom: Presser foot not lifting or lifting incorrectly
checks: Check P173 pause press foot height setting
Check P174 trim press foot height setting
Verify presser foot motor connections are secure
